# Collectron: Whitesprings Robo Butler Station

*Whitespring's legendary service now comes home with the Whitesprings Robo Butler Collectron!*

__Whitesprings Robo Butler Station__

__Overview__

The Whitespring Robo-Butler Collectron Station sends out a courteous and well-programmed servant to gather fine, pre-war household goods and snacks. Perfect for themed CAMPs, kitchens, or anyone with an appreciation for well-preserved cuisine.

__Function__

| **Item Produced** | **Drop Rate** |
| Undamaged Abraxo Cleaner | 5.00% |
| Soap | 11.40% |
| Sugar Bombs (Clean) | 16.72% |
| Toilet Paper | 13.38% |
| Bubblegum | 10.70% |
| Blamco Mac and Cheese (Clean) | 12.80% |
| Dandy Boy Apples | 12.58% |
| Yum Yum Deviled Eggs | 9.73% |
| Cram | 5.43% |
| Salisbury Steak (Clean) | 1.95% |
| Plunger | 0.27% |

- Production Rate: 1 item every 10 minutes and 12 seconds
- Power Required: No
- Lockable: Yes

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 1 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 1 per workshop
- Shares Build Limit With: All other Collectron Stations
- Build Menu Category: Resources
- Shelter Use: No
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 7

__Crafting Requirements__

- 1x Circuitry
- 1x Copper
- 1x Gear
- 3x Steel

__Capacity__

- Storage: Holds up to 10 pounds of collected items

__How to Unlock__

- Season Reward:
 - Season 22 – X – Page X – X Tickets
- Tradeable: No
- Giftable: No

__Build Restrictions__

- Cannot be built inside Shelters
- Only available while in CAMP Mode
